description: This file defines the MidiInputPortSelector class, which manages a user interface component (Spinner) for selecting a MIDI input port and handles opening and closing MIDI device connections accordingly. It extends a base class MidiPortSelector and relies on Android's MIDI API to manage MIDI devices.

classes.name: MidiInputPortSelector
classes.description: A class that manages podcast selection and handling MIDI input ports via a spinner UI component in Android.

methods.name: MidiInputPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the selector with the required MIDI manager, activity context, and layout spinner ID, specifying input port type.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Triggered when a MIDI port is selected from the spinner; opens the device and input port.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the current MIDI input port as a MidiReceiver for receiving MIDI data.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes the MIDI input port and device to release resources.
